skill.displayName: Service Dominant Business Model Design 服务主导逻辑商业模式设计
skill.summary: 服务主导逻辑下的价值共创商业模式设计方法。用于：当需要为特定领域及产品设计以服务为中心、多方价值共创的商业模式时

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Service-Dominant Business Model Design skill.

- Provides a comprehensive methodology for designing service-centric, multi-actor value co-creation business models.
- Introduces key concepts of Service-Dominant Logic and A2A (Actor-to-Actor) framework.
- Outlines a detailed step-by-step process with templates, checklists, and visual tools for ecosystem mapping, value proposition design, co-creation mechanisms, RCOV modeling, service delivery system, and revenue model.
- Includes practical tips, common pitfalls, critical success factors, and reference frameworks.
- Applicable to digital transformation, platform economy, service innovation, ecosystem strategy, sharing economy, and B2B services.
